amendment: A1 -- pre-outcome compute-saving subset + question subsampling
status: written BEFORE any formal ReCoverMem outcome; final_test outcomes remain sealed

persona_subsets.rule: prefix of the ALREADY-FROZEN seed-13 permutation order, not a re-sample
persona_subsets.ordering_reproduced_from: numpy default_rng(13).permutation over the 200 sorted eligible persona ids; slices [0:24]/[24:48]/[48:72] reproduce the parent split exactly (asserted)
persona_subsets.n_cal_note: n_cal = 20 retained so the marginal-CRC floor 1/(n+1) = 0.0476 <= alpha = .05 stays feasible

question_subsampling.rule: deterministic stratified sample over the released pref_type, seed = 13*10^6 + persona_id, largest-remainder quotas, ids sorted within each stratum
question_subsampling.fallback: personas with <= 12 eligible questions use all of them

weighting.rule: average FS / coverage over a persona's selected decisions first, then average equally across personas

documented_deviation.reason: B_out=256 is the value the smoke proved defective: it truncates the released MCQ prompt's reasoning before 'Final Answer: [Letter]', so extract_final_answer returned nothing on 116 of 138 calls. Measured need is 270/350/718 tokens (min/median/max) over 10 held-out predictor_train queries. Retaining 256 would make R_mem and R_rec ~0 for a truncation reason rather than a memory reason. This is an infrastructure correction, not a scientific choice.
documented_deviation.budget_invariance: recomputed: B_avail Q0.05 30,731 -> B_cap 16,384 (unchanged); B_host 2,048 is derived from Mem0 evidence size and is independent of B_out; B_mem = B_rec = 2,048 unchanged
